title: so / neither partial inversion · 典型例句
summary: so/neither indicates 'the same is true (not)' and takes partial inversion, avoiding repetition.本课为典型例句练习,核心:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。
points: So do I = I do too
Neither do I = I don't either
the auxiliary matches the previous sentence
So + subject + auxiliary means indeed so (no inversion)
the tense agrees with the previous sentence

examples.en: I like traveling, and so does my sister.
examples.zh: 我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。

examples.en: He can't drive, and neither can I.
examples.zh: 他不会开车,我也不会。

examples.en: They went to the museum, and so did we.
examples.zh: 他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。

examples.en: I have never been to Xi'an, and neither has he.
examples.zh: 我没去过西安,他也没去过。

examples.en: She is a nurse, and so am I.
examples.zh: 她是护士,我也是。

examples.en: You won't give up, and neither shall we.
examples.zh: 你们不会放弃,我们也不会。

questions.prompt: I like traveling, and _____ my sister.
options: so do
so is
so does
does so
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 so does。句意:我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He can't drive, and can neither I.
He can't drive, and neither can I.

He can't drive, and neither do I.
questions.explanation: so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:He can't drive, and neither can I.

questions.prompt: 「他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。」的正确英文是?
options: They went to the museum, and so were we.
They went to the museum, and did so we.
They went to the museum, and so did we.
They went to the museum, and so do we.
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:They went to the museum, and so did we.

questions.prompt: I have never been to Xi'an, and _____ he.
options: neither does
has neither
neither haven't
neither has
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 neither has。句意:我没去过西安,他也没去过。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She is a nurse, and so am I.
She is a nurse, and am so I.
She is a nurse, and so do I.
She is a nurse, and so is I.
questions.explanation: so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:She is a nurse, and so am I.

questions.prompt: 「你们不会放弃,我们也不会。」的正确英文是?
options: You won't give up, and neither do we.
You won't give up, and shall neither we.
You won't give up, and neither will not we.
You won't give up, and neither shall we.
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:You won't give up, and neither shall we.

title: Cleft sentences It is...that · 典型例句
summary: Cleft sentences emphasize the subject, object or adverbial: It is...that/who..., the tense stays unchanged.本课为典型例句练习,核心:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。
points: emphasizing a person: It is...who...
emphasizing a time/place adverbial: It was...that...
not the predicate can be emphasized
the cleft sentence does not change the sentence's meaning
distinguished from the formal subject It is...that

examples.zh: 是汤姆打破了窗户。

examples.en: It is English that we practice every morning.

examples.zh: 是努力通向成功。

options: It was Tom who broke the window.
It was Tom that whom broke the window.
It was Tom which broke the window.
It was Tom whom broke the window.
questions.explanation: It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was Tom who broke the window.

options: which
who
that
what
questions.explanation: 考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:是努力通向成功。

title: Formal subject it · 典型例句
summary: it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为典型例句练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。
points: It is important to learn English.
It takes time to master a skill.
It is said that... reportedly
It is + adjective + for sb to do
It is kind of sb to do (evaluating a person's character uses of)

examples.zh: 用英语写日记很重要。

examples.en: It takes about an hour to get to the cinema.

options: It is important to keep a diary in English.

getting

options: That is said the bridge has a long history.

options: It is necessary for us taking notes in class.

questions.explanation: It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is no use crying over spilt milk.

title: Formal object it · 典型例句
summary: it acts as formal object, replacing the infinitive or clause object placed after the complement.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。
points: find it + adjective + to do
think it + noun + to do
make it + adjective + that
it refers to the real object placed later
common verbs: find, think, make, consider

examples.en: I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
examples.zh: 我发现每天早晨朗读很有帮助。

title: with compound structures · 典型例句

points: with + noun + adjective: with the door open
with + noun + V-ing: active ongoing
with + noun + past participle: passive or completed
with + noun + prepositional phrase
independent of the sentence's subject

title: Absolute constructions · 典型例句
summary: The absolute construction = noun + adjective/adverb/past participle/infinitive, as an adverbial expressing time, reason or accompanying state.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。
points: the logical subject differs from the main clause subject
noun + past participle: the work finished, ...
noun + adjective: the floor wet, ...
with the absolute can be preceded by with
generally not used in spoken language, common in written expression

examples.zh: 工作完成后,我们高兴地回家了。

examples.en: The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.

title: Non-restrictive relative clauses · 典型例句

points: a comma separates the main clause from the clause
that cannot introduce a non-restrictive clause
who guides a person, which guides a thing
which can refer to the whole previous sentence
the clause can be omitted without affecting the main meaning

Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.
questions.explanation: Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.

questions.prompt: 「为期一周的夏令营昨天结束了。」的正确英文是?
options: The summer camp, what lasted a week, ended yesterday.
The summer camp, which lasted a week, ended yesterday.
The summer camp, that lasted a week, ended yesterday.
The summer camp, who lasted a week, ended yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:The summer camp, which lasted a week, ended yesterday.

the preposition + whom guides a person
the preposition is determined by the collocation in the clause: live in → in which
in non-restrictive clauses that cannot take a preposition
the fixed collocation's preposition cannot be fronted
